title: Predictive Simulations Settings Carbs ratio page is the same like Insulin sensitivity
body:
Dear Team, first a big thank you for this great app.
Unfortunately i figured out some problems during setup of the predictive simulation settings. The page for Carbs ratio page is the same like insulin sensitivity, so i can't enter the values i expect like, 2,5 units for 12g carbo hydrates. Is that working as desired and i'm to stupid to understand or is the page wrong?
BR Carsten

comments.body:
It took me a while to realise that "1 Unit" is always - in both contexts - an Insulin Unit, not a Carb Unit (Carb Units, of whichever size, are used nowhere else).

There's a problem with the adjustment slider though (or yet another misconception on my side?):
If I set the sensitivity to 40 (mg/dL), and the C/I rate to 12, that would mean, eating 12 g of carbs (which raise the BG by 40 points) would require an injection of 1 U to return to the previous level.
Moving the adjustment slider to 150% results in a C/I ratio of 18 and a glucose drop of 26.7 - isn't that the wrong direction? (If I now eat 18 g carbs, I end up with a rise of 60 points which would require more than 2 U of insulin. Where am I wrong?)
